steps.sees: Full-screen Import Work page (header, sidebar, Back and disabled Import buttons visible). Red banner: 'Data Validation Failed. 2 data validation errors were found in the file.' Table: Row 5 cell R5 and Row 6 cell R6, Field 'Working Location (Deck)', Invalid Detail 'The values entered in this multi-value cell contain duplicates. Each value must be unique.' Import button is disabled. The cell values themselves (Helipad,helipad) are not shown on screen.

expectedSources: BA answer Q27 2026-11-24 (work/ETM-8049/ba-answers.md): Import accepts both Helipad and helipad (DEC-046); duplicates rejection is a defect candidate; overrides ETM-1106 AC 4.5 reading
BA answer Q14/Q15 (Story change 2026-11-18): free text saved exactly as entered; case variants stored and shown as separate values
ETM-8049 AC 6.1 (story.md): Excel import (ETM-1008/1106, ETM-6843) is an entry point
ETM-8049 AC 3.6: case variants listed as separate values
problems: Picture does not show the file content; that R5/R6 hold 'Helipad,helipad' rests on the brief, not the screen.
Brief's AC 6.2 quote differs from local story.md (old 'earliest-created work' text); the rule rests on BA Q14/Q15/Q27, not the quoted text.
If 'Helipad' is a Master Data value, AC 6.1 converts both to one spelling, making a real duplicate. Master Data list not checked.
Earlier source (ETM-1106 AC 4.5, ETM-1230 AC 3.1) says in-cell case variants are duplicates; BA Q27 overrides it but the conflict should be cited in the defect.
Only the validation screen is shown; the 'Work and WB created' part cannot be shown since import was blocked (consistent with failure).
summary: ภาพแสดง Import ถูกปฏิเสธที่ R5/R6 Deck ด้วยข้อความ 'contain duplicates' ขัดกับคำตอบ BA Q27 (24 พ.ย.) ที่ว่า Import ต้องรับ Helipad และ helipad แยกกัน จึงถือว่าพิสูจน์ defect ได้ แต่ควรยืนยันว่า Helipad ไม่ใช่ค่า Master Data และ AC 6.2 ที่อ้างในบรีฟไม่ตรงกับ story.md ในเครื่อง
